component.name: Leaf Downloader
component.summary: Modern download manager for Linux with yt-dlp integration

description.p: Leaf Downloader is a high-performance desktop download manager designed specifically for Linux. It combines a custom native segmented download engine with yt-dlp and the elegance of GTK4 and Libadwaita to deliver a blazing-fast, visually stunning, and deeply integrated downloading experience — right at home on GNOME.

ul.li: Dual download engine — IDM-style segmented HTTP downloads and full yt-dlp backend for 1000+ video platforms
Smart Firefox browser extension with YouTube integration, universal video hover bar, and right-click downloads
Native GNOME UI with GTK4 and Libadwaita — sidebar navigation, standalone download card windows with live speed graphs
Intelligent clipboard monitoring — detects copied media URLs and offers one-click downloads
Pause, resume, and cancel with crash-safe resume support via persistent .leafdl manifests
Download queue and persistent history with JSON-based storage
Configurable concurrent fragments, download directory, and API server settings
